name: Nepali Unicode Keyboard
subtitle: English to Devanagari Typing
promotionalText: Type Nepali in any app: "namaste" becomes नमस्ते. Romanized or traditional layout, handwriting, nine themes. Nothing you type leaves your iPhone.
description:
Nepali Unicode Keyboard lets you type Nepali in any app on your iPhone, the way you already type.

ROMANIZED TYPING
Type Nepali with English letters and get Unicode Devanagari. "namaste" becomes नमस्ते, "dherai ramro" becomes धेरै राम्रो. Suggestions above the keys come from a built-in Nepali word list, so common words come out right even when you spell them loosely. A typing guide in the app shows what to type for each letter.

TRADITIONAL LAYOUT
Prefer the traditional Nepali Unicode layout? Switch to it once and it stays. Shift characters show as small hints on each key, and a long press types them. Vowel signs join correctly, so अ + ा gives आ, not अा.

MADE FOR NEPAL
• Dates: type "aaja", "bholi" or a date like 2026-10-21 and get the Bikram Sambat date: २०८३ कार्तिक ४, बुधबार
• Amounts: 1500000 becomes १५,००,००० or पन्ध्र लाख, and "ru 500" becomes पाँच सय रुपैयाँ मात्र for cheques
• Land and gold: "5 aana" shows (१,७११ वर्ग फिट); ropani, bigha, kattha, tola and grams too

WRITE BY HAND
Prefer writing? Tap the pen and write Nepali with your finger. Handwriting is off until you turn it on (see privacy below).

ALSO INCLUDED
• Nepali and English on one keyboard: the flag key switches between English and your Nepali style
• Nine themes, including Himalaya, Lali Gurans and Midnight, or System to follow light and dark mode; turn off key borders for flat keys
• Devanagari numbers (०–९), the danda । and ॥
• Emoji panel with your recently used emoji first
• Clipboard history: your recent copies and pinned items, kept on your iPhone
• Three key heights: Short, Normal and Tall
• VoiceOver reads out the keys and suggestions
• App in English or Nepali

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
This keyboard never sends what you type anywhere, and it doesn't save your typing. Typing, suggestions and emoji work with Full Access off. Full Access is needed only for clipboard history (iOS hides the clipboard from keyboards without it) and for downloading the handwriting model. In password fields, iOS always uses Apple's keyboard. If you turn on handwriting, Google's ML Kit downloads the model and sends Google usage diagnostics (not what you write).

No ads. No sign-in. Free and open source.

Questions or a word the keyboard gets wrong? Use "Send feedback" in the app's settings.
